arxiv-1405-2775.title: Dynamical Generation of the Weak Scale and Inflation in High-Scale Supersymmetry
arxiv-1405-2775.creator: Sibo Zheng
arxiv-1405-2775.description: A 2014 arXiv research paper by Sibo Zheng. Combination of Plank and BICEP2 data reported that tensor to scalar ratio r ≃ 0.16 r\simeq 0.16 and scalar spectral index n s ≃ 0.96 n_{s}\simeq 0.96 . In this short note, it is shown that chaotic inflation with quadratic potential, which perfectly accounts for present fit to r r and n s n_{s} , and relatively heavy Higgs mass for fine-tuned MSSM, are both suggested to be consequences of high-scale supersymmetry (SUSY) breaking.

arxiv-2203-07634.description: Abstract Context. W40 is a heavily obscured bipolar HII region projected in the direction of the Aquila Rift and ionized by hot stars in a central, partly embedded cluster. The study of the cluster and its surroundings has been greatly hampered thus far by the strong extinction in the region. Aims.

arxiv-2204-07400.title: Strength of Correlations in a Silver Based Cuprate Analogue
arxiv-2204-07400.creator: Riccardo Piombo, Daniel Jezierski, Henrique Perin Martins, Tomasz Jaroń, Maria N. Gastiasoro, Paolo Barone, Kamil Tokár, Przemysław Piekarz, Mariana Derzsi, Zoran Mazej, Miguel Abbate, Wojciech Grochala, José Lorenzana
arxiv-2204-07400.description: Abstract AgF 2 \text{AgF}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} has been proposed as a cuprate analogue which requires strong correlation and marked covalence. On the other hand, fluorides are usually quite ionic and 4 ​ d 4d transition metals tend to be less correlated than their 3 ​ d 3d counterparts which calls for further scrutiny.

arxiv-2210-14599.title: RMLStreamer-SISO: an RDF stream generator from streaming heterogeneous data
arxiv-2210-14599.creator: Sitt Min Oo, Gerald Haesendonck, Ben De Meester, Anastasia Dimou
arxiv-2210-14599.description: Abstract Stream-reasoning query languages such as CQELS and C-SPARQL enable query answering over RDF streams. Unfortunately, there currently is a lack of efficient RDF stream generators to feed RDF stream reasoners. State-of-the-art RDF stream generators are limited with regard to the velocity and volume of streaming data they can handle.

arxiv-2304-09483.title: Search for the production of dark fermion candidates in association with heavy neutral gauge boson decaying to dimuon in proton-proton collisions at s = 8 \sqrt{s}=8 TeV using the CMS open data
arxiv-2304-09483.creator: Y. Mahmoud, H. Abdallah and M. T. Hussein, S. Elgammal
arxiv-2304-09483.description: Abstract In this paper, we have done a search for dark matter using a part of the data recorded by the CMS experiment during run-I of the LHC in 2012 with 8 TeV center of mass energy and integrated luminosity of 11.6 fb -1 . This data has been gathered from the CMS open data.

arxiv-2310-01941.title: Bandwidth of Timed Automata: 3 Classes
arxiv-2310-01941.creator: Eugene Asarin, Aldric Degorre, Cătălin Dima, Bernardo Jacobo Inclán
arxiv-2310-01941.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eugene Asarin, Aldric Degorre, Cătălin Dima, Bernardo Jacobo Inclán. Timed languages contain sequences of discrete events (“letters”) separated by real-valued delays, they can be recognized by timed automata, and represent behaviors of various real-time systems. The notion of bandwidth of a timed language defined in [ 17 ] characterizes the amount of information per time unit, encoded in words of the language observed with some precision ε \varepsilon .

arxiv-2310-12031.title: SegmATRon: Embodied Adaptive Semantic Segmentation for Indoor Environment
arxiv-2310-12031.creator: Tatiana Zemskova, Margarita Kichik, Dmitry Yudin, Aleksei Staroverov, Aleksandr Panov
arxiv-2310-12031.description: Abstract This paper presents an adaptive transformer model named SegmATRon for embodied image semantic segmentation. Its distinctive feature is the adaptation of model weights during inference on several images using a hybrid multicomponent loss function. We studied this model on datasets collected in the photorealistic Habitat and the synthetic AI2-THOR Simulators.

arxiv-2406-18615.title: Improving Execution Concurrency in Partial-Order Plans via Block-Substitution
arxiv-2406-18615.creator: Sabah Binte Noor, Fazlul Hasan Siddiqui
arxiv-2406-18615.description: Abstract Partial-order plans in AI planning facilitate execution flexibility and several other tasks, such as plan reuse, modification, and decomposition, due to their less constrained nature. A Partial-Order Plan (POP) specifies partial-order over actions, providing the flexibility of executing unordered actions in different sequences.

arxiv-2506-09425.title: Local surrogates for quantum machine learning
arxiv-2506-09425.creator: Sreeraj Rajindran Nair, Christopher Ferrie
arxiv-2506-09425.description: Abstract Surrogates have been proposed as classical simulations of the pretrained quantum learning models, which are capable of mimicking the input-output relation inherent in the quantum model. Quantum hardware within this framework is used for training and for generating the classical surrogates. Inference is relegated to the classical surrogate, hence alleviating the extra quantum computational cost once training is done.

arxiv-2510-18691.title: Investigating LLM Capabilities on Long Context Comprehension for Medical Question Answering
arxiv-2510-18691.creator: Feras AlMannaa, Talia Tseriotou, Jenny Chim, Maria Liakata
arxiv-2510-18691.description: Abstract This study is the first to investigate LLM comprehension capabilities over long-context (LC) medical QA of clinical relevance. Our comprehensive assessment spans a range of content-inclusion settings based on their relevance, LLM models of varying capabilities and datasets across task formulations, revealing insights on model size effects, limitations, underlying memorization issues and the benefits of reasoning models.

arxiv-2510-24520.title: Crossover from self-trapped bound states to perturbative scattering in the Heisenberg-Kondo lattice model
arxiv-2510-24520.creator: Tanmoy Mondal 1 and Pinaki Majumdar 2
arxiv-2510-24520.description: Abstract We map out the complete transport phase diagram of the ferromagnetic Heisenberg-Kondo lattice model in two dimensions. The model involves tight-binding electrons, with hopping t t , coupled to classical spins with a coupling J ′ J^{\prime} , while the spins have a nearest neighbour coupling J J between them.

pmc-10523551.title: Beyond antibiotic prescribing rates: first-line antibiotic selection, prescription duration, and associated factors for respiratory encounters in urgent care
pmc-10523551.creator: Allan M. Seibert, Carly Schenk, Whitney R. Buckel, Payal K. Patel, Nora Fino, Valoree Stanfield, Adam L. Hersh, Eddie Stenehjem
pmc-10523551.description: Objective:Assess urgent care (UC) clinician prescribing practices and factors associated with first-line antibiotic selection and recommended duration of therapy for sinusitis, acute otitis media (AOM), and pharyngitis.Design:Retrospective cohort study.Participants:All respiratory UC encounters and clinicians in the Intermountain Health (IH) network, July 1st, 2019–June 30th, 2020.

pmc-10806104.title: Explore the effects of forest travel activities on university students’ stress affection
pmc-10806104.creator: Wei-Yin Chang, Xin Wang, De-Sheng Guo, Lam-Huu-Phuoc Nguyen, Ngoc-Huy Tran, Shuai-Jie Yang, Hui-Zhong Lin, Hsiu-Chen Wu, Chin-Fei Huang
pmc-10806104.description: This study aims to explore the effects of forest travel activities on university students’ stress affection. Forty volunteer university students participated in this study. All participants were asked to complete physiological (Heart Rate Variability) and psychological (Brief Profile of Mood State and State–Trait Anxiety Inventory) tests before and after the travel activities.

pmc-12475409.title: First report of DNAI2-associated primary ciliary dyskinesia in Libya: A case from a nonconsanguineous marriage
pmc-12475409.creator: Ziyad Fathi Alatrash, Abdulgader ahmed Elbousify, Ahmed Ibrahim Elbousify
pmc-12475409.description: Primary ciliary dyskinesia (PCD) is an autosomal recessive condition resulting from defects in motile cilia structure and function, impairing mucociliary clearance. This defect predisposes such patients to frequent sinopulmonary infections. The chronic productive cough is a key symptom, with progressive bronchiectasis as a common accompaniment, although diagnosis is delayed, with the mean age at diagnosis being about 11 years.

pmc-12512614.title: Socioeconomic disparities in physiological dysregulation: a longitudinal mediation analysis of cardiometabolic multimorbidity among middle-aged and elderly Chinese
pmc-12512614.creator: Chunyu Yan, Yingyu Jing, Qi Ruan, Ping Liu, Guang Chen
pmc-12512614.description: BackgroundCardiometabolic multimorbidity (CMM) poses a significant health burden among middle-aged and older adults in China, yet early risk prediction remains challenging. The Composite Score of Physiological Variability (CSPV), integrating blood pressure, pulse rate, and body weight fluctuations, may offer a novel tool for assessing CMM risk, but the role of socioeconomic status (SES) in this association is unclear.

pmc-12679951.title: Large Ovarian Fibroma With Torsion in a 17-Year-Old Patient: A Report of a Rare Case of Acute Surgical Abdomen
pmc-12679951.creator: Emmanouil M Xydias, Anna Thanasa, Efthymia Thanasa, Vasiliki Koutsia, Ioannis Tsartsalis, Evangelos Kamaretsos, Apostolos C Ziogas, Ioannis Thanasas
pmc-12679951.description: This study presents a rare case of emergency surgical management via exploratory laparotomy of a large torsed ovarian fibroma in a young female patient. A 17-year-old patient with no history of sexual activity and under chronic antipsychotic medication presented to the emergency department with signs of acute surgical abdomen and fever up to 37.9°C. Laboratory markers of inflammation were elevated.

pmc-13062516.title: Enhanced Left Ventricular Diastolic Function Following Diabetic Foot Treatment: A Prospective Observational Study Investigating the Impact on Cardiac Health
pmc-13062516.creator: Maziar Moayerifar, Mahboobeh Gholipour, Behrad Eftekhari, Anita Khalili, Mani Moayerifar, Mohammad Taghi Ashoobi, Hossein Hemmati, Mohammad Ali Yazdanipour, Golshan Ghasemzadeh
pmc-13062516.description: Background and AimsDiabetes mellitus increases the incidence of diabetic foot syndrome and its concomitant cardiovascular complications, notably diabetic cardiomyopathy (DCM). Approximately 15% of diabetic individuals experience Diabetic Foot Syndrome (DFS), significantly elevating mortality rates. This study evaluates the impact of diabetic foot treatment on cardiac diastolic function in patients with DCM.

pmc-13146614.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1119 THE ASSOCIATION BETWEEN BMI, METABOLIC HEALTH, AND STROKE RISK. A PROSPECTIVE COHORT STUDY WITH TIME-UPDATED COVARIATES
pmc-13146614.creator: Oskar Hultstrand, Anton Jernberg, Eva-Lotta Glader, David Darehed, Marie Eriksson
pmc-13146614.description: Background and aimsThe global prevalence of overweight and obesity is rising, yet the independent contribution of adiposity to stroke risk remains debated, particularly among metabolically healthy individuals.MethodsWe analyzed 132,045 participants from the Northern Sweden Health and Disease Study with repeated health examinations (1985-2022). Stroke events were identified via national registers.

pmc-13165143.title: Sulforaphane in Cutaneous Disorders and Skin Injury: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Clinical Perspectives
pmc-13165143.creator: Hua Liu, Claire Y. Shi, Jed W. Fahey
pmc-13165143.description: Cutaneous disorders such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, acne vulgaris, and rosacea, together with UV-induced skin injury and photoaging, are highly prevalent conditions that involve varying contributions from dysregulated immune responses, cutaneous inflammation, oxidative stress, barrier dysfunction, microbiome alteration, and exogenous injury. However, these conditions are biologically heterogeneous and should not be regarded as a single mechanistic class.

pmc-13361488.title: Investigating the Risk Factors for Medication Nonadherence in Myasthenia Gravis Patients: Establishing a Nomogram Model
pmc-13361488.creator: Chaoying Liu, Simei Ning, Ping Lu, Wenli Jia, Xiaohe Zhang, Guoyan Qi
pmc-13361488.description: ObjectiveMany studies have shown that MG patients often show poor adherence to their medications. Poor adherence may affect disease control, and also put a heavy burden on patients’ physical functions and medical costs. Therefore, this study aimed to develop and verify a nomogram for predicting medication adherence in MG patients.

pmc-13371548.title: Into the future: first robotic totally endoscopic coronary artery bypass in Southeast Asia
pmc-13371548.creator: Dudy Arman Hanafy, Sudhir Prem Srivastava, Widya Trianita Suwatri, Jenni Pratita, Muhammad Eros Zulfikar Syafruddin, Bimo Kusumo, Dicky Aligheri Wartono, Sugisman
pmc-13371548.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCoronary artery bypass grafting remains the most commonly performed cardiac surgery worldwide, including in Indonesia. Robotic approach offers a minimally invasive alternative benefiting both patients and surgeons. Nonetheless, its adoption remains limited globally.Case presentationWe report Southeast Asia’s first robotic totally endoscopic coronary artery bypass performed at Harapan Kita National Heart Centre, Indonesia in November 2024 using SSI Mantra™ Surgical Robotic System, highlighting key aspects in robotic program initiation including structured team training, patient selection, operative workflow, and management of intraoperative challenges during

pmc-13382494.title: H7F ameliorates DSS-induced colitis through restoration of intestinal barrier function and inhibition of IL-17/NF-κb signaling
pmc-13382494.creator: Lili Zhou, Rufei Huang, Jialiang Liang, Wei Sun, Huan Xia, Xinghe Zhou, Xiaolan Zhong, Wanglin Li, Zhaoyang Wang
pmc-13382494.description: IntroductionInflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic relapsing disorder of the gastrointestinal tract for which effective and safe therapeutic options remain limited. H7F is an in-house herbal formula developed in our hospital based on clinical practice and traditional Chinese medicine theory. This study aimed to investigate the therapeutic effects of H7F on experimental colitis and to explore the underlying mechanisms.

pmc-13384126.title: Clinicians’ decision-making about broad-spectrum antibiotic prescribing for suspected maternal sepsis during childbirth in the UK: a qualitative study
pmc-13384126.creator: Carol Kingdon, Benjamin Greenfield, Caroline Cunningham, David Freeman, Damien Ming, David Lissauer, Alison Holmes, Abi Merriel
pmc-13384126.description: AbstractObjectiveSepsis management and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) are linked priorities. Early identification and treatment of sepsis with broad-spectrum antibiotics are key to reducing morbidity and mortality. We aimed to investigate clinicians’ decision-making about broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected maternal sepsis in women admitted to hospital for childbirth, to identify if, how and why overtreatment may occur.DesignQualitative study.

pmc-13556372.title: 428. ADHD: neurocognitive pathways
pmc-13556372.creator: Q Luo
pmc-13556372.description: BackgroundADHD is characterized by its clinical heterogeneity in symptoms and their trajectories. However, both cognitive impairment and motivational dysfunction in the well-known ‘dual-pathway model for ADHD’ can be absent in about 30% of ADHD cases and cannot predict the persistence or remitting of the symptoms.

pmc-13568207.title: Parameter-Efficient Audio-Visual Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition with Mamba Fusion Adapters and Frame-Level Feature Arrangement
pmc-13568207.creator: Kangbo Ning, Shanshan Gao, Zhaoqiang Xia, Dong Huang, Lei Li
pmc-13568207.description: Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition (DFER) has recently attracted significant interest due to its vital role in enabling empathetic and human-compatible technologies. Developing models that remain robust under in-the-wild variability is a key motivation for DFER research and its practical applications. Improving models through multimodal learning, which leverages audio and video data for richer, complementary representations, is one promising direction.

pmc-13620192.title: Recurrent prostate adenocarcinoma after radical prostatectomy: Principles of multidisciplinary management across a spectrum of disease
pmc-13620192.creator: Amar U Kishan, Yulia Zekster, Adam E Singer, Kekoa Taparra, Luca F Valle, Michael L Steinberg, Nicholas G Nickols, Robert E Reiter, Johannes Czernin, Jeremie Calais, John K Lee, Lawrence R Hardesty, Matthew B Rettig
pmc-13620192.description: Short abstractA case vignette is presented of a patient with recurrent prostate cancer after radical prostatectomy, covering the spectrum from biochemical recurrence to metastatic disease. The patient provides his insight into this journey as he is treated on serial clinical trials as the disease recurs.
